Lina C: quick flag — onboarding cust-vela LoRA into staging; small smoke shows currency cents dropped on long-context runs. evalpack at gs://redwood-evals/cust-vela-invoice-quick.json :link:
Omar H: example?
Lina C: prompt 0003 'Amount: $9,876.54' -> '9,876' or '9876' intermittently when conversation >2k tokens.
Jules: did their finetune include custom tokenizer? any tokenmap provided?
Lina C: yes they used vela_tok_patch.json; merge applied directly without rebasing token ids.
Omar H: run tokenmap diff: `tools/tokenmap_diff.py --base models/vela-base/tokenizer.json --other customer/tokenizers/vela_tok_patch.json`
Omar H: diff shows punctuation/digit ids moved (e.g., `".": 60 -> 520`).
Jules: LoRA embedding keys bind to old ids -> numeric tokens map wrong. Remap script `scripts/rebase_lora_tokenids.py` should help.
EvalBot: queued quick-eval job ej-104500 on dedicated-gpu-7.
Omar H: plan: fp16 baseline, int4 without remap, int4 with remap. compare cents-preservation metric.
EvalBot: done: fp16 99.3%, int4 w/o remap 69.7%, int4 with remap 96.7%. logs /mnt/results/ej-104500/summary.json
Lina C: conclusion: auto-detect tokenizer mismatch in onboarding pipeline and run remap. I'll open tiny PR adding remap step + smoke test asserting currency cents preserved.
